Yours wth all the inclosed are safe arrived wch you wrate the 22. of Aprill and
wee received the 14. of May.
The D. d’Aumale was receaved here this day wth greate honor the Count Fuentes
being on his right hand and the Duke de Feria (almost madde wth melancholye,
moch 93 hath written agaynst him to Spayne to disable him for this
government) on his left. He pretendeth to come a begging partlye for
dewes for forage given to our Campe partly for some benevolence, yet the
Spanyardes wold make men beleve that he cometh wth some great enterprise
quasi vero cum nec habeat Civitatem nec Castellum quod vendat nec militem
vel sequaces quorum opera vtatur. xv. Maij.
16. hath talked long wth me and vttered soch matter
agaynst 20. that 36 easelye may perceave that he hath bene
instructed in the scole of 31. 32. and 40. yet I salved him
merelye well. He sayd inter alia that yong Tempeste there was deboshed
by Signor Hugo, and had deboshed the Scollers wch yow tooke so muche agaynst
him 28. so putt him owt, that 20. shamefully had sowght the
voyces of 29. ut loqueretur in persona aliorum and before he departed
I made him protest another matter.
I thinke 23. accusing to 93 will prove Brownes doing 24.
for sweareth it although he invaye infinitelye agaynst 42. and wold
fayne have 23. renownce him vt libere in eum posset sævire
although I thinke truly 42. hath done 23 more harme
then good.
82. is angry first that 24. 113. 147. et alij give out
that 90. was offred to 73. who demaunding whether there were
any men arrived and vnderstanding quod non, refused 90. wch 82.
telleth 36. in secrett is a flatt lye, but to the Ende
pagador shold know nothing, 90. being gotten out of
his handes he was sent to Catnesse into the North. Quicquid sit
82. iurat se nunquam cum 83. habiturum rem etiam si
2. imperet. My Nuncio told 36. for assured that Perone
was not yet departed towardes 105. and that 2. was madde
wth 82. for those letters and if 72. proceded not in the
demaund of absolution that all wold be imputed to 82. letters
